newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Renak to raise A$11.9 mln from Phileo.
newsitem.headline: Renak to raise A$11.9 mln from Phileo.

text.p: Retail liquor shop and property owner Renak Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it planned to issue 14 million shares and 14 million free attaching options to Phileo Land Berhad for 85 cents a share to raise A$11.9 million.

The funds raised from the share placement, which was subject to regulatory and shareholder approval, would be used to partly finance the purchase of a property at Dandenong, near Melbourne, and to reduce bank debt.
The placement would increase Phileo Land's stake in Renak to 74 percent from 48 percent.
Renak also announced the appointment of Jason Sau Lee Yeap as managing director.
Renak's shares were unchanged at 59 cents at 12.20 p.m. (0220 GMT).
